modules.module_title: Prepare for service and repair work

pcs.pc_description: determine the work requirements such as type of tasks to be performed (repair, maintenance, etc.), HEMM to be maintained from work instructions, manuals, site visits, etc.
identify the auto component manufacturer specifications related to the various components/aggregates in the HEMM
review complaint sheet, log book and history sheet of the equipment and understand repair requirements
identify and arrange tools, consumables, spare parts, etc. required for performing service and repair work
inform relevant departments about the service and repair work to be performed and obtain approval before starting the work

modules.module_title: Perform service, repair and overhaul of electrical/electronic aggregates of HEMM

pcs.pc_description: shut down the HEMM properly by disconnecting all primary and secondary energy sources safely
inspect the HEMM for defects and faulty parts/components by carrying out standard checks
diagnose direct or indirect faults in HEMM electrical/electronic systems as per OEM SOP
fix and verify that lockout has been successful and attach a lockout or tagout device to the HEMM to ensure that it cannot be started without removing the device
dismantle the HEMM and disconnect the faulty parts from it safely
check all wirings and electrical connections for any faults, damage, loose connections, etc.

inspect the HEMM for charge leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, unusual contact of electrical wires with moving parts, erratic/problematic performance or any other problem as reported in the complaint
repair all electrical and electronic faults including direct faults in input sensors, output actuators, wiring harnesses etc. as per SOP/WI
repair indirect faults in electrical/electronic aggregate due to another system/component
remove, replace, and repair relevant parts in various aggregate of the HEMM as per SOP
report any malfunctions/repairs in the machine beyond own scope to the concerned person
assemble back the covers, guards, clamps, insulation etc. of the HEMM after service and repair
update the Maintenance Data Sheet (MDS) on the HEMM
check the performance of HEMM post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
record all repairs carried out, parts disposed and replaced, time taken and other significant findings observed during the work process
dispose-off materials such as old batteries, scrap of failed parts/aggregates as per organization’s policies
report information such as service and work done, faults observed, action taken, parts replaced, etc. to the supervisors accurately

check for damaged insulation and shielding to prevent electrical short circuits or exposure risks
